topic: GPT-6 Astra: The AI That Can Take Over Your Computer
weak_angle: How GPT-6 Astra's new features work.
strong_angle: The moment AI stopped waiting for humans to click the buttons and started operating the computer itself.
central_question: What changes when AI stops merely generating answers and starts operating the digital world itself?
stakes: If models can reliably navigate live software environments, the foundation of knowledge work and cybersecurity fundamentally changes.
promise: By the end of this documentary, the viewer will see exactly what Astra can do, where it breaks, and what its autonomous agency means for the future.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Disorient the viewer with an uncanny event: an autonomous cursor moving at 2:13 AM with hands off the keyboard.
beats.revealed_mystery: Computers have waited for humans for decades. Now the computer is listening to an AI instead.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Demonstrate the capability physically on screen: browser opening, navigation, terminal, multi-app montage.
beats.revealed_mystery: Astra doesn't just generate text; it navigates the digital environment directly.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Hard cut to black with thesis typography: THE COMPUTER IS NO LONGER THE TOOL. IT'S THE ENVIRONMENT.
beats.revealed_mystery: Software shifts from being an instrument for human hands to an ecosystem for autonomous agents.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Zoom into official documentation and OSWorld 2.0 benchmark results (72.6% vs 65.7%).
beats.revealed_mystery: Verified numbers confirm a 6.9% leap over previous state-of-the-art across live operating systems.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Show real developer workflow: command execution, test failure, error inspection, patch adaptation, success.
beats.revealed_mystery: The breakthrough is not flawless execution—it is closed-loop self-correction.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Expose OpenAI's Safety Overview marking Astra as reaching the Critical Cybersecurity threshold.
beats.revealed_mystery: The same agentic agency that debugs software can autonomously exploit systems.

beats.dramatic_purpose: Final blackout beat: When the machine can operate the machine, who is actually in control?
beats.revealed_mystery: The boundary between human labor and autonomous infrastructure has permanently shifted.
